Annual Report. The Office shall, within three months after the end
of every fiscal year, submit its annual report to the President.

Initial
Fund. To carry out the provisions of this Executive Order,
the release of the initial sum not exceeding TEN MILLION PESOS (P10,OOO,OOO.OO)
hereby authorized chargeable against the Organizational Adjustment Fund under
the 1999 GAA (R.A. 8745). Thereafter, the budget of the Office and the Committee
shall be integrated in the annual budget of the Office of the President.

Effectivity.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
